# Theme Token — Technical Reference

Theme Token publishes ShadCN-compatible themes as 1Sat Ordinals on BSV. The
Theme Token JSON document is the durable on-chain source. themetoken.dev is the
validation, preview, discovery, and ShadCN registry gateway.

## URLs

- Specification: https://themetoken.dev/spec
- Stable v1 schema: https://themetoken.dev/v1/schema.json
- Gateway-preview v2 schema: https://themetoken.dev/v2/schema.json
- Theme Studio: https://themetoken.dev/studio/theme
- Registry item: https://themetoken.dev/r/themes/[origin].json
- Raw 1Sat content: https://api.1sat.app/content/[origin]
- SDK: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@theme-token/sdk

The suffixless registry route also works. Public examples use `.json`:

```bash
bunx shadcn@latest add https://themetoken.dev/r/themes/[origin].json
```

`[origin]` is a canonical 1Sat origin outpoint: 64 lowercase hexadecimal
characters, an underscore, and a non-negative output index.

## Two different JSON layers

Do not confuse the durable Theme Token document with the generated registry
response:

1. `[origin]/theme.json` is the protocol document stored in an `ord-fs/json`
   package.
2. `/r/themes/[origin].json` validates that document and compiles a ShadCN
   `registry-item.json` response for the CLI.

## Stable Theme Token v1 document

Root requirements:

- `$schema`: exactly `https://themetoken.dev/v1/schema.json`
- `name`: non-empty display name
- `styles.light` and `styles.dark`: complete style maps

`author`, `css`, `bundle`, and `generation` are optional.

Each style map requires these 19 values:

- `background`, `foreground`
- `card`, `card-foreground`
- `popover`, `popover-foreground`
- `primary`, `primary-foreground`
- `secondary`, `secondary-foreground`
- `muted`, `muted-foreground`
- `accent`, `accent-foreground`
- `destructive`, `destructive-foreground`
- `border`, `input`, `ring`

Each style map also requires `radius`. Additional string-valued CSS variables
are allowed. Common optional variables include `chart-1` through `chart-5`, the
eight sidebar variables, font families, letter spacing, spacing, shadows, and
legacy background-image fields.

The Studio emits complete CSS color values such as `oklch(0.55 0.22 255)`,
matching current ShadCN themes. The v1 validator accepts CSS strings and does
not enforce OKLCH. Do not wrap complete values in another `oklch()` call.

Theme Token v1 requires `destructive-foreground` for compatibility with
existing documents. Current ShadCN's core token list requires `destructive` but
does not require that paired field.

AI generation provenance is optional:

```json
{
  "generation": {
    "prompt": "required when generation is present",
    "provider": "optional",
    "model": "optional",
    "timestamp": 1770000000000
  }
}
```

The v1 `bundle` and background-image fields are legacy, unverified relationship
mechanisms. New relationship-aware work belongs in v2.

## Theme Token v2 gateway preview

Version 2 keeps the v1 `name`, `author`, `styles`, `css`, and `generation`
fields, changes `$schema` to `https://themetoken.dev/v2/schema.json`, and
requires an `assets` array.

Each relationship declares:

- a semantic `role`
- `kind`: `font`, `pattern`, `wallpaper`, or `icon`
- a sibling output or external origin source, optionally with an ord-fs path
- canonical `mediaType`
- `integrity` in `sha256:<64 lowercase hex>` form
- optional `delivery`, `required`, and background `render` settings

The current gateway compiler supports:

- `font.sans`, `font.serif`, `font.mono`, and `font.heading`
- `background.page`, `background.card`, and `background.sidebar`
- linked verified fonts, patterns, and wallpapers
- vendored verified UTF-8 assets such as SVG patterns

Binary fonts and raster images cannot be vendored. Required `icon.set` delivery
is not implemented. Missing required indexed content produces a retryable
gateway error; media-type and integrity mismatches are hard failures.

The Theme Studio and `@theme-token/sdk` currently author, validate, and fetch v1
documents. Use v2 only as the documented gateway relationship contract until
those clients are upgraded.

## Storage and MAP discovery

New themes are `ord-fs/json` packages containing `theme.json`. MAP metadata is
attached to the package directory manifest:

```json
{
  "app": "theme-token",
  "type": "registry:style",
  "name": "Theme Name",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Theme Name"
}
```

Theme Token uses `registry:style` as the historical discovery identifier for
existing theme inscriptions and currently emits the same type from its gateway.
Current ShadCN distinguishes `registry:theme` (color themes) from
`registry:style` (component styles). A migration must preserve discovery of v1
inscriptions and therefore cannot silently rename existing on-chain metadata.

Current MAP mappings:

| Package | MAP fields | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Theme | `type=registry:style` | Stable compatibility identifier |
| Font | `type=theme-token:asset`, `kind=font`, `mediaType=...` | Published |
| Pattern | `type=theme-token:asset`, `kind=pattern`, `mediaType=image/svg+xml` | Published |
| Wallpaper/image | `type=theme-token:asset`, `kind=wallpaper` or `image`, `mediaType=...` | Published |
| Project preset | `type=registry:base` | Experimental draft |

All package MAP records include `app`, `type`, `name`, `version`, and
`description`. Asset records also include `kind` and `mediaType`. `author`,
`license`, `prompt`, `provider`, and `model` are optional provenance fields.

## Registry response

`GET /r/themes/[origin].json` fetches `[origin]/theme.json`, validates it, and
returns a ShadCN registry item. A v1 response currently uses `registry:style`
for compatibility:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema/registry-item.json",
  "name": "theme-name",
  "type": "registry:style",
  "css": {
    "@layer base": {
      "body": { "letter-spacing": "var(--tracking-normal)" }
    }
  },
  "cssVars": {
    "theme": { "radius": "0.625rem" },
    "light": { "background": "oklch(1 0 0)" },
    "dark": { "background": "oklch(0.145 0 0)" }
  }
}
```

The current ShadCN CLI accepts this response. Verify a concrete origin with:

```bash
bunx shadcn@latest add https://themetoken.dev/r/themes/[origin].json --dry-run
```

## SDK (v1)

```ts
import {
  applyTheme,
  fetchThemeByOrigin,
  parseCss,
  toShadcnRegistry,
  validateThemeToken,
} from "@theme-token/sdk";

const published = await fetchThemeByOrigin("<txid>_0");
if (!published) throw new Error("Theme not found");
applyTheme(published.theme.styles.light);
```

- `validateThemeToken(data)` validates v1 documents.
- `parseCss(css, name)` parses `:root` and `.dark` variables into v1.
- `fetchThemeByOrigin(origin)` loads packaged v1 themes with a legacy direct
  content fallback.
- `toShadcnRegistry(theme)` emits the current compatibility
  `registry:style` response.
- `applyTheme(styles)` applies one `ThemeStyleProps` map, not a whole
  `ThemeToken` object.

## Experimental project presets

The project publisher and `/init?project=[origin]` route predate ShadCN's current
top-level `registry:base` fields (`style`, `iconLibrary`, `baseColor`, and
`theme`). They are not part of the stable protocol and should not be used as a
production example until migrated and verified end to end with the latest CLI.

The intended future command is:

```bash
bunx shadcn@latest create --template next --preset "https://themetoken.dev/init?project=[origin]"
```

## Scope

The JSON format is portable, but themetoken.dev publishing, discovery,
ownership, marketplace, and gateway behavior currently target BSV 1Sat Ordinals.
Friendly registry, preview, and optimized-media URLs depend on gateway
infrastructure. Consumers that need independent verification can fetch durable
content by origin from compatible 1Sat infrastructure.
